genealogy.notes: Japanese is the main language of the Japonic family, in the Japanese branch. The only other branch is Ryukyuan (the languages of Okinawa and the southern islands), which is not mutually intelligible with Japanese; none of its languages is in the app registry, so there are no related language tags. No relationship to Korean or Chinese has been shown: much of the vocabulary and the kanji come from Chinese, but that is borrowing, not family. Broad family metadata for orientation only.
